# Anime.js 4.5.0

`anime.esm.min.js` is the unmodified browser ESM bundle from the installed
`animejs@4.5.0` npm package (`dist/bundles/anime.esm.min.js`). It is served locally
so animation enhancements do not depend on a CDN. Its MIT license is included
in `LICENSE.md`.

Source: https://github.com/juliangarnier/anime
Documentation: https://animejs.com/documentation/

SHA-256: `a19015a1a92d52025a2fb6703b6d67eadd1cc2aeaf880770e96e04cf6aa07be1`

Used by button feedback, company scene text transitions, and compositor-backed
hero motion via `waapi.animate()`. Section entrances use the native Web Animations
API. Navigation and content remain usable if these optional modules
cannot load.
